verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway computes an accurate per-request cost figure and explicitly states this cost figure is meant to support 'budget enforcement, per-consumer spend limits, and chargeback' (docs-33, docs-18), and it has an AI Rate Limiting Advanced plugin that can apply limits per consumer/key (docs-12/43). However, the evidence never documents a concrete enforcement mechanism that hard-caps spend by dollar amount per key/team/user (rate limiting appears request/token-count based, not dollar-budget based), so it reads as an underlying capability/building block rather than a demonstrated hard-budget feature. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a spend-limit/budget policy entity, proof that limits can be set in currency terms per key/team/user, and enforcement behavior (e.g., blocking requests once a dollar budget is exhausted).
